svg.text: Made from include/pins.h by tools/make_wiring_diagram.py · guide: docs/phase1_assembly.md
DevKitC-1 in the breadboard, seen from above
USB ports point to the far end of the breadboard. Rows are counted from that end.
blue - rail (GND), over the USB end
FTS02 2×20 socket, seen from the back of the FTS02
Board face-down, socket edge towards you, “P1” at the right (as in your photo). Column n from the right holds pin 2n−1 (edge row) and 2n (inner row).
Every hole not marked stays empty. Never connect the DevKitC's 5V pin or the socket's 5V pins (2, 4).
